items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 22 at 11:00AM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
At 1058 AM PDT, strong showers and thunderstorms will continue
across southeastern Ventura and central Los Angeles Counties.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and penny size hail. A brief weak
tornado is possible.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Long Beach...
Oxnard...
Thousand Oaks...
Simi Valley...
Camarillo...
Fillmore...
Acton...
Encino...
Inglewood...
Manhattan Beach...
Agoura Hills...
Venice...
Rancho Palos Verdes...
Hollywood...
Van Nuys...
Alhambra...
Mount Wilson...
Culver City...
Torrance...
and Universal City.
items.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
localized flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.

Frequent cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Lightning can strike 10 miles away from a thunderstorm. Seek a safe
shelter inside a building or vehicle.

items.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 22 at 10:57AM PDT until October 22 at 2:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall continues. Canyon rock and mudslides possible.

* WHERE...Southern and Eastern Los Angeles County in southwestern
California...

* WHEN...Until 200 PM PDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways. Canyon rock and mud slides possible. Minor
debris flows possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1056 AM PDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. This  will cause urban and small stream flooding
and potential rock and canyon mud slides, and minor debris flows.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Long Beach, Wrightwood, Whittier, West Covina, Glendora, San
Dimas, Pomona, Torrance, Redondo Beach, Rancho Palos Verdes, La
Verne, Carson, Port of Los Angeles, Rolling Hills, Hacienda
Heights, Santa Fe Springs and Norwalk.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
items.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles. Campers and hikers should avoid streams or
creeks.

items.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued October 21 at 10:08AM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
A moderate storm system will impact our coastal waters today
through Thursday, bringing a chance of thunderstorms to the area.
Thunderstorm activity is likely to be most hazardous for the
waters south and east of Point Conception with peak timing
expected this afternoon through Thursday morning.

Any thunderstorm that forms will be capable of producing local
gusts up to gale force, rough seas, dangerous lightning, heavy
rainfall with reduced visibility, and waterspouts.
